notes: Read SKILL.md and references/api_reference.md, chunking_and_compression.md, integration.md, performance_and_patterns.md, review.md, storage_backends.md, v3_migration.md in full. Guide to Zarr-Python 3.4.0: array/group creation, chunking, codecs, sharding, storage backends (local, ZIP, fsspec, ObjectStore, S3/GCS/HTTP), Dask/Xarray integration, and v2-to-v3 migration with validation.

Tells the agent to install pinned packages (SKILL.md:27,29 `uv pip install "zarr==3.4.0" ...`), write local .zarr/.h5/.npy stores in examples, and run the zarr CLI (`zarr migrate v3`, `zarr remove-metadata v2` in v3_migration.md:56-57,76-77) on a copied store with a --dry-run first and only after validation. Remote S3/GCS examples use the user's own cloud credentials (anon=False, token="google_default") with read-only opens and explicit advice never to put keys in notebooks, logs or attributes. Medium because of package installs, local writes/metadata removal, and optional cloud credential use; acceptable because versions are pinned, destructive steps are confined to a copy with dry-runs, and no secrets are read or transmitted.
